title: The rule audit scopes each binding to the branch that reads it, so a second hit in judge() no longer hides a refusal's reason
why: When one name is bound twice in judge(), the audit reads the wrong binding and reports a refusal with no reason.
note: Topic guard-coverage. In lint/test_rule_audit.py, _locals scopes each binding to the branch that reads it. From main, its own PR. Retires the debt that #1738's rename names as a bandaid. Lane mcp-tools-in-guard-matcher, on the coordinator's word; filed 20:25 CST Nov 7.
